description: Project store dimension attributes at the most granular level

measures.name: 30 days
measures.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

measures.name: 31-60 days
measures.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 30 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

measures.name: 61-90 days
measures.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 60 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 90) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

measures.name: 91-120 days
measures.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 90 AND sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk <= 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

measures.name: >120 days
measures.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk > 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

description: Aggregate at the store location level with full address details
